info.name: WatchRate API Suite
info.description: CRUD + negative + data-driven tests for the WatchRate REST API. Run folders in order (or the whole collection) with the WatchRate Local environment.

exec: pm.test("Movie has an id and matches input", () => { pm.expect(json.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(json.title).to.eql("Inception"); pm.expect(json.duration).to.eql(120); });
pm.test("New movie has no ratings yet", () => { pm.expect(json.averageRating).to.eql(null); pm.expect(json.ratingCount).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("Response is an array containing the created movie", () => { pm.expect(json).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(json.map(m => m.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("movieId"))); });
pm.test("Rating saved, average is 5", () => { pm.expect(json.rating.rating).to.eql(5); pm.expect(json.averageRating).to.eql(5); });
pm.test("Average of 5 and 3 is 4", () => { pm.expect(json.averageRating).to.eql(4); pm.expect(json.ratingCount).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Review created with id", () => { pm.expect(json.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(json.reviewer).to.eql("Riya"); pm.expect(json.rating).to.eql(4); });
pm.test("Review updated", () => { pm.expect(json.comment).to.eql("Better on the second watch."); pm.expect(json.rating).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Average of 5, 3, 2 is 3.33 from 3 ratings", () => { pm.expect(json.averageRating).to.eql(3.33); pm.expect(json.ratingCount).to.eql(3); });
pm.test("Total minutes is 210 across 2 viewers", () => { pm.expect(json.totalMinutes).to.eql(210); pm.expect(json.viewers).to.have.lengthOf(2); });
